ABOUT THE COMPANY
================================================================================

Town & Country Title Guaranty has been Florida's trusted partner for title insurance and closing services since 1976. Founded by Paul Guitard, the company was built on principles of integrity, honesty, and exceptional service.

With over 99 years of combined experience among our team members, we have successfully completed more than 10,000 real estate closings across Florida. We serve homebuyers, sellers, real estate agents, lenders, and attorneys throughout the state.

Our Mission:
To protect Florida homebuyers and property owners with comprehensive title insurance and seamless closing experiences, delivered with integrity and professionalism.

SERVICES DETAILED
================================================================================

1. TITLE INSURANCE
------------------
Title insurance protects property owners and lenders against financial loss from defects in property titles. We offer:

Owner's Title Insurance:
- Protects the property owner's equity
- One-time premium at closing
- Coverage lasts as long as owner or heirs own property
- Covers legal defense costs
- Protects against unknown liens, forgery, fraud, errors

Lender's Title Insurance:
- Required by most mortgage lenders
- Protects the lender's investment
- Coverage equals loan amount
- Decreases as loan is paid down
- Expires when loan is paid off

2. TITLE SEARCH SERVICES
------------------------
A thorough examination of public records to verify property ownership and identify potential issues:

Search Types:
- Full Title Examination
- Current Owner Search
- Two-Owner Search
- Judgment and Lien Search
- Municipal Lien Search
- HOA/Condo Association Search

Timeline: Standard searches take 3-5 business days
Expedited options available for time-sensitive transactions

3. CLOSING SERVICES
-------------------
Complete real estate closing support from contract to keys:

Services Include:
- Document Preparation

- Recording Services
- Post-Closing Services

On-Location Closings:
- We come to your home, office, or any convenient location
- Available throughout all 67 Florida counties
- Flexible scheduling including evenings and weekends

================================================================================
TITLE INSURANCE INFORMATION
================================================================================

What Title Insurance Covers:
- Unknown liens (mortgages, judgments, tax liens)
- Forgery and fraud in prior transactions
- Errors in public records
- Undisclosed heirs claiming ownership
- Invalid deeds in the chain of title
- Boundary and survey disputes
- Legal defense costs

Florida Title Insurance Rates:
Florida regulates title insurance rates statewide. Premiums are based on the property value or loan amount:

Approximate Owner's Title Insurance Costs:
- $200,000 property: ~$1,325
- $300,000 property: ~$1,725
- $400,000 property: ~$2,125
- $500,000 property: ~$2,575

Note: These are estimates. Contact us for an exact quote.

Who Pays for Title Insurance in Florida:
Most Counties: Seller pays for owner's title insurance
Buyer-Pays Counties: Miami-Dade, Broward, Sarasota, Collier
Note: This is negotiable between parties

================================================================================
CLOSING COST INFORMATION
================================================================================

Typical Buyer Closing Costs in Florida (2-5% of purchase price):
- Loan Origination Fee: 0.5-1% of loan amount
- Appraisal Fee: $350-$600
- Title Insurance (Lender's): Based on loan amount
- Title Search: $150-$350
- Closing Fee: $350-$600
- Recording Fees: $10-$200
- Documentary Stamps on Mortgage: $0.35 per $100
- Intangible Tax: $0.20 per $100 of loan
- Prepaid Items: Varies (taxes, insurance, interest)

Typical Seller Closing Costs in Florida (6-10% of sale price):
- Real Estate Commission: 5-6%
- Documentary Stamps on Deed: $0.70 per $100
- Title Insurance (in buyer-pays counties): Based on sale price
- Property Taxes: Prorated
- HOA Estoppel: $100-$400

================================================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: What is title insurance?
A: Title insurance protects you from financial loss if someone challenges your ownership of a property or if defects in the title are discovered after closing.

Q: Is title insurance required?
A: Lender's title insurance is required by most mortgage lenders. Owner's title insurance is optional but strongly recommended.

Q: How long does a title search take?
A: Standard title searches take 3-5 business days. Expedited searches are available.

Q: Do you offer mobile/on-location closings?
A: Yes, we provide on-location closing services throughout Florida at no additional charge.

Q: Can I choose my own title company?
A: Yes, you have the right to select your title insurance company.

Q: What happens if a title problem is found?
A: We work to resolve issues before closing. If problems arise after closing, title insurance covers the costs.

Q: How long does title insurance last?
A: Owner's title insurance lasts as long as you or your heirs own the property.

Q: Do I need new title insurance when refinancing?
A: You'll need new lender's title insurance. Your original owner's policy remains in effect.
